REPLACE:renaissance_plausible_location = {
	# Project Phoenix v9.5 (Rule #12 oe_rule_dynamic_institutions): 100% vanilla when off; high-merit Eurasian/Global branch when enabled.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_owner = yes
			OR = {
				area = area:emilia_area
				area = area:lombardy_area
				area = area:piemonte_area
				area = area:tuscany_area
				area = area:veneto_area
				area = area:liguria_area
			}
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
				has_building_with_at_least_one_level = university
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = dominant_culture_is_owners_culture
				dominant_culture = owner.culture
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = yes
			oe_cul_origin_req_renaissance = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:banking_plausible_location = {
	# Project Phoenix v9.5 (Rule #12 oe_rule_dynamic_institutions): 100% vanilla when off; high-merit Eurasian/Global branch when enabled.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_owner = yes
			num_pop_type:burghers > 1.0
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = dominant_culture_is_owners_culture
				dominant_culture = owner.culture
			}
			OR = {
				continent = continent:europe
				sub_continent = sub_continent:north_africa
				sub_continent = sub_continent:middle_east
			}

			owner = {
				societal_value:capital_economy_vs_traditional_economy < -50
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = yes
			oe_cul_origin_req_banking = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:professional_armies_plausible_location = {
	# Project Phoenix v9.5 (Rule #12 oe_rule_dynamic_institutions): 100% vanilla when off; high-merit Eurasian/Global branch when enabled.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			continent = continent:europe
			has_owner = yes

			custom_tooltip = {
				text = dominant_culture_is_owners_culture
				dominant_culture = owner.culture
			}
			modifier:local_manpower > 0

			owner = {
				societal_value:quality_vs_quantity < -10
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = yes
			oe_cul_origin_req_professional_armies = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:printing_press_plausible_location = {
	# Project Phoenix v9.5 (Rule #12 oe_rule_dynamic_institutions): 100% vanilla when off; high-merit Eurasian/Global branch when enabled.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			owner ?= {
				produced_in_country:paper > 5
			}
			has_institution = institution:renaissance

			num_pop_type:burghers > 1
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = university

			owner = {
				societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative > 20
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = yes
			oe_cul_origin_req_printing_press = yes
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:global_trade_plausible_location = {
	# Project Phoenix v9.5 (Rule #12 oe_rule_dynamic_institutions): 100% vanilla when off; high-merit Eurasian/Global branch when enabled.
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_institution = institution:banking
			has_institution = institution:new_world

			OR = {
				continent = continent:europe
				sub_continent = sub_continent:north_africa
			}

			is_market_center = yes
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
			}
			market = {
				total_goods_value_traded > 500
			}
		}
		AND = {
			oe_cul_dynamic_origin_eligible = yes
			oe_cul_origin_req_global_trade = yes
		}
	}
}
